character.lede: A craftsman lake house stands in the water, with a glazed prow, a long catslide roof and a fieldstone chimney. A dark deck with a telescope looks over the pond, and a planted bank runs down to it.

spots.line: Rocking chairs and a telescope face the pond from the deck.
An easel, a bookshelf and a gallery wall surround the desk.
A crib, a changing table and a glider fill the nursery.

facts.style: Craftsman lake house standing in the water: a greige gable block with a glazed prow, a long catslide over a set-back upper floor with a fieldstone breast and chimney, a slate-sided single-storey wing with a clerestory and a glass corner, a planted bank and a dark deck with a telescope over the pond

character.truths: The Core sits on the desk in the Study. The house has a television in the Living Room and a kitchen with a breakfast bar. Lake deck with a telescope, pond, planted bank. The nursery is upstairs.
